papers.title_en: MemCut: Every Secret Leaves a Trail in the Long-Term Memory of LLM Agents
papers.authors: Cheng Zhang, Xuanning Cao, Zhicheng Zheng, Hui Xiong
papers.evidence: LLM智能体长期记忆中的用户请求遗忘
papers.tldr: 长期记忆是LLM智能体的关键组件，但系统还需按用户请求遗忘敏感数据。作者提出MemCut基准，用456条长程对话中的手工秘密及完整证据链，评估删除后的原生恢复与残余恢复，并建立三种参考删除基线。结果显示，删除披露消息主要降低原生恢复，残余恢复仍高；LLM引导多删十轮后仍有39-76%残余恢复，扩大候选池比删光原始候选更能抑制残余恢复。该工作揭示现有记忆设计难以可靠遗忘，并指出候选覆盖是瓶颈。
papers.abstract_en: Long-term memory has become a crucial component of large language model (LLM) agents, with most research focusing on retrieving relevant information accurately and efficiently. However, a dependable memory system must also forget sensitive user data upon request. To evaluate this capability, we introduce MemCut, a systematic benchmark for user-requested forgetting. Its 456 hand-designed secrets in long-horizon conversations have fully annotated evidence trails to test recovery after deletion, including from messages that never state the secrets directly. We propose two recovery metrics. Native recovery measures reader success through the system's retrieval, whereas residual recovery measures the same reader's success when directly given surviving objects traced to annotated disclosures or evidence. We establish three reference deletion baselines to test how far existing retrievers and write models support forgetting across five memory designs and four LLMs. Disclosure removal reduces native recovery far more than residual recovery. LLM-guided deletion of ten additional turns from twenty retrieval candidates leaves 39-76% residual recovery. Subset sweeps (144 facts, three systems, two models) show that widening the pool at a fixed budget reduces residual recovery more than deleting all original candidates. These sweeps identify candidate coverage as a bottleneck in the reference baselines.

papers.title_en: Beyond Downstream QA: Rethinking How We Evaluate Agent Memory
papers.authors: Sebastian-Antonio Toma, Jean de Kernier, Mike Ply, Oliviu Matei
papers.evidence: 重新审视智能体记忆评估的基准
papers.tldr: 现有Agent记忆评测以下游问答准确率作为代理，混淆记忆正确性与检索生成质量，既会漏报坏记忆也会误伤好记忆。作者提出FEB-30基准，用30条事实演化轨迹覆盖6类诊断与3档难度，通过范式反转由已知事实轨迹生成文档，获得无需人工标注的确定性真值。在代表性记忆系统上，内在与外在评测平均相差16个百分点，44%轨迹超过显著分歧阈值；记忆操作分类正确率仅20%。该工作揭示下游QA评测盲区，并发布基准、生成管线与评分框架。
papers.abstract_en: Agent memory benchmarks evaluate whether an agent's responses reflect correct knowledge, measuring downstream question-answering accuracy as a proxy for memory quality. We show this evaluation paradigm is incomplete: it conflates memory correctness with retrieval and generation quality, producing both false positives where correct responses mask broken memory and false negatives where incorrect responses blame correct memory for retrieval failures. We introduce FEB-30, a benchmark of 30 fact-evolution trajectories spanning 6 diagnostic categories and 3 difficulty levels, constructed via paradigm inversion: documents are generated from known fact trajectories, yielding deterministic ground truth without human annotation. Each trajectory defines how a fact should evolve across multi-author artifacts (documents, emails, conversations), enabling direct inspection of the memory store after each ingestion step. Applying FEB-30 to a representative memory system, we demonstrate that intrinsic and extrinsic evaluation diverge by an average of 16 percentage points, with 44% of trajectories exceeding meaningful divergence thresholds. Diagnostic decomposition reveals that the system correctly classifies memory operations (create, update, reinforce, supersede) only 20% of the time, a failure entirely invisible to extrinsic evaluation, and that failure modes differ systematically by category and difficulty. We release the benchmark, document generation pipeline, and scoring framework to support reproducible evaluation of agent memory systems.

papers.title_en: Learning Personalized Memory Gating from Delayed One-Sided Feedback
papers.authors: Kaixuan Ji, Zixiang Chen, Wenting Zhao, Cheng Qian, Heng Wang, Weizhi Zhang, Jielin Qiu, Liangwei Yang, Quanquan Gu, Silvio Savarese, Shelby Heinecke, Huan Wang
papers.evidence: 面向LLM智能体长期记忆存取的事实级记忆门控
papers.tldr: 长期记忆可让语言模型智能体个性化交互，但有限记忆库无法保留所有事实，现有门控策略又多为用户共享，难以匹配各自复用模式。作者在事实级用检索结果标注记忆价值，并把在线门控建模为带延迟单边反馈的上下文苹果品尝问题，提出 Warm-Start UCB 结合离线学习与在线适应用户。理论给出延迟窗口不超过 O(√T) 时的高概率遗憾上界，实验在不同记忆预算与历史长度下均优于基线。该工作为个性化记忆门控提供了可学习且可理论分析的方案。
papers.abstract_en: Long-term memory enables language-model agents to personalize future interactions, but a finite memory bank cannot preserve every extracted fact. Existing memory gating policies are typically shared across users and therefore fail to account for user-specific patterns of future reuse. In this paper, we study memory gating at the fact level. We first propose a retrieval-based labeling strategy that labels each fact by whether it is later retrieved and incorporated into responses. We then formulate online memory gating as contextual apple tasting with delayed one-sided feedback, and propose Warm-Start UCB, which combines offline learning from existing data with online adaptation to the current user. Our theoretical analysis establishes a high-probability regret upper bound of $\tilde{O}(Tε\wedge d\sqrt{T})$ when the delay window is at most $O(\sqrt{T})$, where $T$ is the total number of rounds, $ε$ is the initialization error, $d$ is the dimension of the feature map, and $\tilde{O}(\cdot)$ hides constant and poly-logarithmic factors. The results of our experiment demonstrate that our method outperforms all baselines under different memory budgets and history lengths, establishing it as a promising personalized memory gating policy.

papers.title_en: MemDerive: A Diagnostic Benchmark for Agent Memory over Evolving Data
papers.authors: Sen Gao, Yongan Li, Han Chen, Bingsheng He, Ming Wu, Jason Zeng, Michael Heinrich, Shixuan Sun
papers.evidence: 面向演化数据的智能体记忆诊断基准
papers.tldr: 长时智能体需记忆由多条历史记录按规则推导出的状态，但现有基准只评分最终答案，难以定位遗漏或过时状态。MemDerive用符号化场景与Datalog生成金标准，记录推导DAG和支撑事件，并将历史渲染为含干扰项的自然语言，还跟踪事件到达后的答案正确性；含10场景、4692事件、1503查询。评测中四种记忆系统在派生状态上均不如BM25，给定支撑事件时答案模型达96.01%，多数失败源于中间状态未被取回，隐式变化也少被传播。
papers.abstract_en: Long-running agents rely on memory of their past interactions for task state, such as what has been completed and which conditions still hold. Such state is usually a derived state. No record states it, and it must be computed by rules from multiple records of an evolving history. Existing memory benchmarks score only the final answer, with no reference for the intermediate states behind it. A wrong answer therefore cannot be traced to the state that was missed, and a state that silently became outdated goes undetected. We present MemDerive, a diagnostic benchmark for agent memory over evolving data. It specifies each scenario symbolically, derives exact gold answers with Datalog, records the gold derivation DAG and the supporting events of every query, and renders the history in natural language with fictional entities and distractors. Its 10 scenarios contain 4,692 events and 1,503 queries whose difficulty varies along access, evolution, and composition. On this ground truth, MemDerive evaluates answer reliability, diagnoses failures by probing the nodes of the gold derivation DAG, and tracks whether answers stay correct as events arrive. Our evaluation of four memory systems reveals failures that final-answer benchmarks hide. On derived state, every memory system falls behind simple BM25 retrieval, although the same answer model reaches 96.01% when given the supporting events. Most failures are ungathered, as a system holds the missing intermediate state but does not retrieve it for the question that needs it. Memory systems also rarely propagate implicit changes, which no new record states. These results suggest three principles for memory design. Gather inputs along the derivation, store rules with their versions, and maintain derived states through recorded dependencies.

papers.title_en: Procedural Memory for Language Agents: A Neurosymbolic Perspective on Explicit Goal Structure
papers.authors: Jonathan Leung, Zhiqi Shen, Deheng Ye
papers.evidence: 面向语言智能体的显式程序性记忆架构
papers.tldr: 大语言模型在需要程序性推理的长时程任务上仍不可靠，作者认为关键原因是缺少可访问、可修改的显式程序记忆。为此，文章从神经符号视角提出用目标导向图表示目标与前置依赖，把任务完成知识组织为可检查的符号结构。文中不报告实验结果，而是讨论构图方法、面临挑战及与神经推理的整合原则。其贡献在于为语言智能体补足显式程序记忆提供概念框架与设计方向。
papers.abstract_en: Large language models remain unreliable on long-horizon tasks requiring procedural reasoning. We argue that a key cause is the absence of explicit procedural memory: accessible, modifiable knowledge of how tasks are accomplished, distinct from semantic and episodic memory. Goal-Oriented Graphs offer such a representation, encoding goals and prerequisite dependencies as inspectable symbolic structure. We examine their construction, the challenges they pose, and principles for integrating them with neural reasoning.

papers.title_en: The Geometry of Agent Memory: Forecasting Retrieval-Bound Memory Failures, and Characterizing Its Limits
papers.authors: Iliya Zhechev, Radoslav Ralev, Chris Coleman, Srijith Rajamohan, Jen Agarwal, Tyler Hutcherson, Simba Khadder
papers.evidence: 预测智能体记忆实现中检索受限的记忆失效
papers.tldr: 研究对话轮次、记忆文本与查询之间的几何关系能否在生成前预测答案正确性。作者在共享嵌入空间比较四种记忆实现与一种摘要基线，用25个特征训练逻辑分类器。LongMemEval-small上汇总AUROC为0.640，低于问题难度基线0.655；控制难度与系统身份后几何特征无稳定增益。结果表明几何邻近只能刻画关联，尚不足以作为可靠部署诊断。
papers.abstract_en: We study whether geometric relationships between conversation turns, memory texts, and queries can predict answer correctness before generation. We evaluate four memory implementations with dense or hybrid retrieval and one observation-summary comparator. We embed these texts in a shared space. A logistic classifier uses 25 features describing query proximity, memory-conversation correspondence, and conversation structure. On LongMemEval-small, pooled AUROC is 0.640 over 2,367 question-system pairs, below a question-difficulty baseline of 0.655. Performance varies by question type: geometry reaches 0.841 on single-session-assistant questions, but system identity alone reaches 0.826. After controlling for difficulty and identity, geometry adds no statistically established pooled improvement (delta = +0.002, 95% CI [-0.010, 0.014]). A fixed-store context-selection experiment finds higher accuracy with proximity-ranked memories than with random subsets, consistent with ordinary retrieval relevance. On LoCoMo, nearest-turn similarity has modest predictive value for single-hop questions and near-chance estimates for several other categories. Training uses correctness labels; prediction uses pre-answer features and no additional LLM generation call. The results characterize associations between memory representations and correctness, rather than establish a reliable deployment diagnostic. In particular, embedding proximity does not verify fact coverage or distinguish memory-construction, retrieval, and generation errors.

papers.title_en: LAMB: Latent Multi-Hypothesis Beliefs for Long-Horizon Large Language Agents
papers.authors: Peien Ding, Hui Li, Yuhan Liu, Jinsong Su
papers.evidence: 长程智能体的潜空间多假设信念记忆
papers.tldr: 长程语言智能体需紧凑记忆，既保留交互证据又维护未观测状态的多重假设；离散文本记忆反复压缩易丢证据或过早淘汰备选。LAMB以Common–Delta分解融合共享证据与加权假设分量，用动作-结果预测的相对证据循环更新潜在多假设，无需生成文本记忆。在ALFWorld、BabyAI、ScienceWorld和Crafter上匹配或超越PABU，ALFWorld SR@30与ScienceWorld成功率分别提升6.0和22.0个百分点，Crafter进度提升26.37点。这表明潜在多假设信念可作为长程决策的紧凑有效记忆。
papers.abstract_en: Long-horizon language agents require compact memories that retain interaction evidence while preserving competing hypotheses about unobserved states. Although effective, many belief-state methods encode memory in discrete natural language, where repeated compression can omit evidence or prematurely discard plausible alternatives. We introduce LAMB, a recurrent framework for latent multi-hypothesis beliefs. A Common--Delta factorization combines a shared Common state for interaction evidence with weighted Delta components for competing hypotheses. Relative evidence from action-outcome predictions guides recurrent hypothesis updates without generating textual memory. A context-conditioned readout exposes hypotheses separately to the policy through a fixed-token belief prefix in the default configuration. The belief modules and policy are jointly trained using action imitation and auxiliary state, outcome, and observation-discrimination objectives. Across ALFWorld, BabyAI, ScienceWorld, and Crafter, LAMB matches or outperforms PABU, improving ALFWorld SR@30 and ScienceWorld success by 6.0 and 22.0 percentage points, respectively, and Crafter achievement progress by 26.37 points. On ALFWorld, it also reduces the redundant-action rate by 17.70 percentage points. These results support latent multi-hypothesis beliefs as compact memory for effective long-horizon decision making

papers.title_en: ProMemAgent: Long-Horizon Proactive Assistance with Context-Aware Prospective Memory from Sensory Perceptions
papers.authors: Lilin Xu, Linyang He, Kaiyuan Hou, Yuang Fan, Minghui Zhao, Xuhai Xu, Xiaofan Jiang
papers.evidence: 面向LLM智能体的前瞻记忆机制
papers.tldr: 现有LLM主动式助手多只应对即时需求，难以处理需数小时甚至数天后才执行的延迟意图。ProMemAgent将前瞻记忆引入日常感官上下文，把第一视角视频与音频组织为上下文感知记忆并生成前瞻线索，在当前情境下检索相关往事并进行记忆增强推理以判断是否主动帮助。作者还提出CPMBench基准，含8类日常场景共1000个实例。实验显示其记忆检索最佳，长时程主动辅助持续超越所有基线。
papers.abstract_en: Large language model (LLM) agents are moving beyond reactive responses toward proactive assistance that anticipates user needs without explicit requests. However, existing proactive agents primarily address immediate needs, while many everyday situations involve delayed intentions that can only be acted on hours or days later. Humans handle such intentions through prospective memory, the ability to remember to act on an intention when the right moment arises. In this paper, we introduce ProMemAgent, the first proactive agent to incorporate prospective memory over everyday sensory contexts for long-horizon proactive assistance. ProMemAgent organizes past sensory perceptions (e.g., egocentric video and audio) into context-aware memory, generating prospective cues and linking earlier events with subsequent developments for future retrieval. Given the current context, it retrieves relevant past events and performs memory-augmented proactive reasoning to determine whether assistance is needed. We further introduce CPMBench, the first benchmark for evaluating long-horizon proactive assistance over sensory contexts, comprising 1,000 instances across eight everyday categories. Extensive experiments show that ProMemAgent achieves the best memory retrieval performance and consistently outperforms all baselines on long-horizon proactive assistance.

papers.title_en: More Memory, Worse Agents: Error Reproduction and Anti-Persistence in LLM Agents
papers.authors: Ruhan Wang, Kishan Panaganti, Dongruo Zhou
papers.evidence: 智能体将经验存入外部记忆并经检索复用，导致错误复现
papers.tldr: LLM智能体常把执行经验存入外部记忆以自我改进，但持久保存规则、摘要和技能等抽象会通过检索复用传播错误，并在执行与再抽象循环中反复再生。Anti-Persistence改为只累积轨迹与结果，按需用自适应选择器合成任务指导，并在执行后丢弃。多基准与多骨干实验中，它取得更高留出成功率与最低平均LLM调用成本。该工作揭示抽象持久化的反效果，主张分离经验积累与抽象持久化。
papers.abstract_en: LLM agents can improve across tasks without updating model parameters by storing experience from their own executions in external memory and reusing it to guide later decisions. A central design question is whether to retain only observed trajectories and outcomes or also the rules, summaries, and skills inferred from them. Retaining these abstractions allows agents to reuse strategies without repeatedly deriving them from raw trajectories. However, errors in stored abstractions can propagate to subsequent decisions through retrieval and reuse. They can also shape execution trajectories, which then become the basis for new abstractions that reproduce the original errors. We term this feedback mechanism error reproduction: errors are regenerated through a cycle of abstraction, execution, and re-abstraction, extending their persistence beyond direct reuse of the original faulty knowledge. We propose Anti-Persistence, a memory design that accumulates trajectories and outcomes while reconstructing task-specific guidance on demand. An adaptive selector uses prior outcomes to decide whether and how to synthesize guidance, which is discarded after execution. This prevents its direct reuse as a stored object, although indirect feedback through retained trajectories remains possible. Across different benchmarks and backbones, Anti-Persistence achieves higher overall held-out success and the lowest average LLM-call cost among the evaluated memory designs. These results support separating experience accumulation from abstraction persistence in memorybased self-improvement.

papers.title_en: Is Complex Agentic Memory Always Needed? Naive RAG Is Stronger Than We Thought
papers.authors: Zhengye Bao, Shengtao Zhang, Haokai Zhang, Shiqi Lou, Muning Wen, Minnan Luo
papers.evidence: 以朴素RAG检索原始历史作为长期记忆基线
papers.tldr: 大模型长期记忆常被做成复杂智能体记忆系统，但这类复杂性是否必要存疑。作者提出Raw-RAG，仅用稠密检索加 rerank 在原始对话历史上取证据交给读者模型。在LoCoMo、LongMemEval、MEME、MemoryAgentBench上，它在7个基准-模型设置中6个排名第一，领先最强智能体记忆0.13至5.53分。分析显示原始证据覆盖率高可抵消利用率不足，挑战复杂记忆必要性并确立朴素RAG基线。
papers.abstract_en: LLM memory is widely used in long-term conversation understanding. Agentic memory systems often use mutation, structural organization, learned retrieval strategies, or other complex operations. Is this complexity always necessary? We study Raw-RAG, a naive RAG baseline using dense retrieval and reranking over raw history to supply evidence to a reader LLM. Across LoCoMo, LongMemEval, MEME, and MemoryAgentBench, Raw-RAG ranks first among the compared memory systems in six of seven benchmark-model settings, outperforming the strongest compared agentic memory system by 0.13-5.53 points. We investigate why raw-history retrieval remains competitive. Evidence analysis shows that its higher coverage of necessary evidence can offset lower utilization. Useful evidence includes both answer values and the relations and dependency paths needed to derive them. Even complete access to transformed memory stores leaves an accuracy gap relative to raw evidence, highlighting the importance of preserving raw information. These findings challenge the necessity of complex agentic memory for the evaluated conversation tasks and establish naive RAG as an essential baseline.

papers.title_en: Bridging Semantic Gaps in RAG through Generated Context Knowledge Fusion
papers.authors: Xinkai Du, Chao Lv, Yalin Sun, Quanjie Han, Lei Yao, Maosong Sun
papers.evidence: 对齐查询与检索上下文语义空间的检索增强生成框架
papers.tldr: 检索增强生成（RAG）虽能结合检索与生成，但查询与检索上下文之间存在语义空间错配，制约段落选择质量。为此，本文提出知识感知语义桥接框架KASB，通过智能知识融合对齐查询与文档的语义空间。该方法融合生成式与检索式知识的互补优势，以多阶段过程同时提升相关性与准确性。在三个开放域问答数据集上的实验验证了有效性，为缓解RAG语义鸿沟提供了新思路。
papers.abstract_en: Retrieval-Augmented Generation has established itself as a fundamental framework in natural language processing, seamlessly integrating information retrieval with the generative capabilities of large language models. However, this process is fundamentally constrained by a critical challenge: semantic space mismatch between queries and retrieved contexts. We propose Knowledge-Aware Semantic Bridging (KASB), a novel framework that improves passage selection quality through semantic space alignment between queries and retrieved documents through intelligent knowledge fusion. Our approach leverages the complementary strengths of generative and retrieval-based knowledge through a multistage process that enhances both relevance and accuracy. We evaluate KASB on three popular open-domain Question Answering datasets to demonstrate the effectiveness of our approach.

papers.title_en: When Correct Memory Goes Wrong: Fuzzing Persistent Memory Use in LLM Agents
papers.authors: Yuqiao Meng, Luoxi Tang, Yingxue Zhang, Yuchen Yang, Zhaohan Xi
papers.evidence: U-Fuzz对LLM智能体的持久记忆使用进行模糊测试，暴露查询与状态相关失败
papers.tldr: 持久记忆让LLM智能体跨轮次保留信息，但即使记忆内容正确，查询变化或记忆状态演化也会导致错误使用。现有工作多关注记忆内容错误或固定测试，难以系统发现此类失效。作者将问题建模为模糊测试，提出U-Fuzz：以记忆检查点为种子，按显式变异义务改写查询或记忆状态，验证变异体并用记忆行为指导迭代搜索。实验在多种记忆系统和仅输出场景中稳定发现更多已确认失效，说明该搜索方法跨架构有效且适用受限观测。
papers.abstract_en: Persistent memory helps LLM agents carry information across long interactions, but correct memory can still be used incorrectly when queries change or memory states evolve. Existing work mainly studies memory content errors or evaluates fixed test cases, leaving memory-use failures hard to discover systematically. We formulate this issue as a fuzzing problem and categorize such failures into query-related and memory-state failures. We then develop U-Fuzz, which starts from memory checkpoints as test seeds, mutates queries or memory states under explicit mutation obligations, validates each mutant, and uses observed memory behavior to guide iterative testing while keeping failure labels outside the search. We evaluate U-Fuzz across several memory systems against diverse fuzzing baselines, and further test an output-only setting with API-based LLMs where memory retrieval is hidden. Across these settings, U-Fuzz consistently uncovers more confirmed memory-use failures, showing that its search remains effective across different memory architectures and even when only final responses are observable.

papers.title_en: MemLeak: Cross-User Semantic Leakage in Multi-Tenant AI Agent Memory
papers.authors: Priyanka Mudgal, Kai Zhao, Guilin Zhang, Andy Olsen, Ezekiel Miller, Xu Chu, Aletta Johanna Blanken
papers.evidence: 多租户AI智能体长期向量记忆的跨用户语义泄露
papers.tldr: 企业多租户AI agent共享向量记忆库时，普通余弦检索即可召回他人语义邻近记忆，构成跨用户准入失败。MemLeak用TF-IDF与MiniLM-L6-v2开展六组实验及消融，覆盖附带泄漏、对抗植入和端到端污染。同团队池化检索泄漏达70%–100%，对抗记忆top-k放置达90%–100%，响应污染最高5.00/5且常被评为更有帮助。三种缓解中仅检索后硬性所有权门控恢复1.00/5，每查询开销约1.4 ms。
papers.abstract_en: Personal AI agents in enterprise multi-tenant deployments share a common vector store for long-term memory. Shared embedding spaces create a surface for cross-user memory leakage: a user's query can retrieve semantically adjacent memories belonging to another user through ordinary cosine-similarity retrieval, without any exploit. We formalize this as cross-user admissibility failure and evaluate it across six experiments, plus follow-up ablations, under both sparse (TF-IDF) and production-faithful (MiniLM-L6-v2) retrieval. Non-adversarial, incidental leakage reaches 70--100\% under pooled {same-team} retrieval; adversarially crafted memories achieve 90--100\% top-$k$ placement, exceeding weaker keyword-based attacker baselines, with score lifts of $+0.416$ to $+0.511$ under production-faithful dense retrieval (Config B); and end-to-end response contamination reaches 5.00/5 under a production retrieval path and 4.67/5 with Claude Sonnet~4.5, with contaminated responses often scoring as helpful or more helpful than clean ones, a gap validated against human judgment. Among three architectural mitigations, only hard post-retrieval ownership gating consistently restores the clean baseline (1.00/5) across {two generation models, at a measured latency overhead of roughly 1.4~ms per query.

papers.title_en: From Memory to Guide: Spatio-Temporal Composer for Procedural Coding Memory
papers.authors: Zhixuan Tan, Pengjie Gu, Zhao Li, Yihan Hu, Xu He, Dong Li, Jianye Hao
papers.evidence: 记忆增强智能体将检索到的过程记忆用作策略
papers.tldr: 记忆增强智能体通常把检索到的技能直接注入文本提示，这会把可读文本误当成可靠执行。为此，论文提出“从记忆到引导”新范式，并实现时空编排器 Composer，在推理时对检索知识做空间适配与时间编排，将其编译为有边界的运行时指南，且无需更新任何参数。在 EngramBench 的 13 项长程软件工程任务上，最复杂任务的绝对通过率提升 7.2 个百分点，主智能体 token 用量下降 32.2%。
papers.abstract_en: Memory-augmented agents typically integrate procedural knowledge by injecting retrieved skills directly into text prompts. This approach dangerously equates readable text with reliable execution. To bridge this gap, we introduce From Memory to Guide, a novel paradigm that transitions procedural memory from passive text delivery to active, inference-time policy adaptation. We instantiate this paradigm through the Spatio-Temporal Composer, an active policy compiler that explicitly manages exactly how and when retrieved knowledge should be applied. Rather than treating skills as plug-and-play modules, Composer dynamically aligns historical knowledge with current environmental constraints (spatial adaptation) and precisely dictates its applicable lifecycle (temporal orchestration). It actively transforms static memories into strictly bounded Runtime Guides---equipping the agent with localized objectives and behavioral guardrails without requiring a single parameter update. Extensive evaluations on 13 demanding, long-horizon software engineering tasks in EngramBench demonstrate the clear advantages of this architecture. Composer not only robustly prevents context mismatch but drives an absolute pass-rate increase of 7.2 percentage points on the most complex tasks, while simultaneously slashing the main agent's token usage by 32.2%.

papers.title_en: QREF: Improving DeepSearch Agents by Aligning Search with Reasoning via Query Refinement and Evidence Filtering
papers.authors: Yujia Chen, Yuhui Wang, Junzhe Wang, Shihan Dou, Di Liang, Yujiong Shen, Yuhao Zhou, Zhiheng Xi, Ming Zhang, Senjie Jin, Jiayi Chen, Dingwei Zhu, Yajie Yang, Yuan Hua, Chenyao Lu, Tao Gui, Qi Zhang, Xuanjing Huang
papers.evidence: 查询精炼与证据过滤使搜索与推理对齐
papers.tldr: DeepSearch智能体常产生意图偏离、约束不足或冗余查询，造成证据覆盖差和检索噪声累积。QREF是即插即用的查询精炼器与证据过滤器：按当前推理意图重写查询并保证批次互补覆盖，同时过滤与搜索批次和推理目标相关的证据。在四个基准上，它使WebSailor和TongyiDeepResearch的Pass@1平均相对提升33.55%和11.04%，RL精炼器将缺乏判别性检索锚点的查询批次比例降低95%。无需改架构或重训推理策略即可增强DeepSearch。
papers.abstract_en: DeepSearch agents achieve strong performance on complex information-seeking tasks through iterative search and reasoning. However, they often issue intent-misaligned, under-constrained, or redundant search queries, resulting in poor evidence coverage and accumulating retrieval noise. To mitigate these limitations, we propose QREF, a plug-and-play Query Refiner and Evidence Filter. Specifically, the Query Refiner rewrites search queries according to the current reasoning intent while ensuring complementary coverage across each search batch. The Evidence Filter retains evidence relevant to both the current search batch and the reasoning objective, reducing distracting retrieval results. We initialize the Query Refiner with supervised fine-tuning and optimize it through reinforcement learning based on interactions with a real-world web search environment, reducing ineffective queries. Comprehensive experiments demonstrate that our approach improves the performance of DeepSearch agents across four challenging benchmarks, achieving average relative Pass@1 improvements of 33.55% on WebSailor and 11.04% on TongyiDeepResearch without modifying architectures or retraining their reasoning policies. Compared with the original DeepSearch backbone without QREF, the RL-trained refiner reduces the fraction of query batches that lack discriminative retrieval anchors by 95%. Compared with the SFT-trained refiner, it also lowers the filter-based ineffective query ratio.

papers.title_en: Learning to Program Retrievals: Composing Search Primitives via Reinforcement Learning
papers.authors: Kyuyoung Kim, Zilin Xiao, Zhiyuan Wang, Avinash Atreya, Ke Yang, Jinwoo Shin, Kecheng Hao
papers.evidence: 将搜索原语组合为程序以支持多步检索增强流程
papers.tldr: 现有检索增强模型多依赖固定流水线或原子工具，难以灵活组合多步搜索。作者提出检索程序学习RPL，让策略把搜索原语编排成带局部状态与控制流的可执行程序，并用程序变异生成局部变体、经执行验证后蒸馏回策略以缓解稀疏反馈。在开放域问答和语料级推理上，RPL稳定提升性能，多跳任务增益显著，4B模型超过所有8B基线，并降低上下文消耗与检索轮次。
papers.abstract_en: Retrieval-augmented language models increasingly use multi-step search to solve knowledge-intensive tasks, yet existing systems typically expose retrieval through fixed pipelines or collections of atomic tools. We introduce Retrieval Program Learning (RPL), a programmable search framework that allows a policy to compose search primitives into executable programs with local state and control flow. This enables adaptive search that can retrieve broadly, process intermediate results, and selectively construct model context without tying retrieval breadth to context consumption. However, the resulting flexibility creates a difficult exploration problem: useful programs may require several coordinated decisions, while reinforcement learning often supplies only sparse feedback. To address this challenge, we propose program mutation, a grammar-constrained and execution-verified procedure that generates local variants of suboptimal programs sampled during RL, converts them into training trajectories, and distills them back into the policy. We evaluate RPL on open-domain question answering and corpus-level reasoning tasks, comparing it with a range of retrieval and reasoning baselines. RPL consistently improves open-domain QA performance across model sizes and in- and out-of-domain benchmarks, with particularly large gains on multi-hop tasks. Notably, a 4B model trained with RPL outperforms all 8B model baselines. On corpus-level reasoning, RPL achieves the highest answer F1 and document-coverage F1 for both model sizes while substantially reducing context consumption and retrieval turns. Our results show that programmable search expands the retrieval strategies that agents can learn, while program mutation provides an effective mechanism for exploring useful program structures beyond direct on-policy sampling.

papers.title_en: Deep Fusion Memory: A Chunk-Level Parametric Memory for Large Language Models
papers.authors: Rubin Wei, Siyuan Sun, Hao Sun, Yuliang Liu, Xiang Shi, Jiarui Wang, Junming Zhang, Zhouhan Lin
papers.evidence: 将学习到的记忆融入隐状态的分块级参数化记忆架构
papers.tldr: 大模型需外部知识，但继续预训练易灾难性遗忘，推理检索开销大；现有参数化记忆构建数据需大量离线检索且融合较浅。DFM 用因果记忆预测器由前文生成块级记忆，以语料块嵌入监督，并通过门控交叉注意力融入各 token 隐状态，主干冻结端到端训练，推理无需显式检索。其构建数据所需检索查询少32倍、检索项少2048倍；六个问答任务较最强基线在 Mistral-7B-v0.3 和 Qwen3-8B-Base 上分别提升12.71%和11.19%。
papers.abstract_en: Large language models need effective ways to acquire and use external knowledge beyond what they retain from pretraining. Continued pretraining risks catastrophic forgetting, while retrieval at inference time can add substantial overhead. External parametric memory avoids online retrieval, but constructing its training data requires extensive offline search, and output-level interpolation provides only shallow fusion. We introduce Deep Fusion Memory (DFM), a parametric memory architecture that reduces this construction workload and incorporates learned memory into intermediate hidden states. A causal memory predictor learns to generate memory from the preceding context, using retrieved chunk embeddings from the corpus as supervision. The predicted memory is shared across tokens within each chunk and fused into their hidden states through gated cross-attention. Memory prediction and fusion are trained end to end with the backbone frozen, and inference requires no explicit retrieval. Compared with existing parametric memory approaches, which often construct token-level memory targets, DFM requires $32\times$ fewer retrieval queries and $2048\times$ fewer retrieved items to construct its training data. Across six QA tasks, DFM performs better over the strongest baseline by 12.71% on Mistral-7B-v0.3 and 11.19% on Qwen3-8B-Base. Beyond QA, domain adaptation yields average gains of 6.51 and 4.38 points over Qwen3-4B-Base and Qwen3-8B-Base, respectively.

papers.title_en: MEMORA: A Memory-Enhanced Multimodal Committee Reranking Agent for Reasoning-Intensive Retrieval
papers.authors: Mohamed Mahmoud, Mostafa Farouk Senussi, Mahmoud Abdalla, Mahmoud SalahEldin Kasem, Abdelrahman Abdallah, Hyun Soo Kang
papers.evidence: 带情景记忆模块的记忆增强重排序智能体
papers.tldr: 推理密集型检索在查询需深层语义推断且以多模态形式出现时表现受限，现有系统孤立处理查询、依赖单一重排器且缺少跨模态推理检索器。MEMORA 以协作因子委员会重排、情节记忆模块和推理感知稠密检索器，将查询分解为意图因子并融合记忆动态调整优先级。在 MM-BRIGHT 的29个领域上，其 nDCG@10 达41.5（文到文）和38.9（多模态查询到文），较最强纯文本与多模态智能体基线分别提升8.3和7.9分。该工作展示了记忆增强多智能体协同对复杂跨模态检索的有效性。
papers.abstract_en: Reasoning-intensive retrieval is fundamentally challenged when queries demand deep semantic inference and arrive in multimodal form. Existing systems treat each query in isolation, rely on monolithic rerankers, and lack retrievers trained for cross-modal reasoning. We introduce MEMORA, a Memory-Enhanced Multimodal Orchestrated Reranking Agent built around three contributions: (1) Collaborative Factor-Committee Reranking, which decomposes queries into intent factors, extracts factor-specific evidence into a structured matrix, and synthesizes judgments via a memory-conditioned meta-verdict model; (2) an Episodic Memory Module that tracks factor outcomes across queries and dynamically adjusts priorities at inference time; and (3) a Reasoning-Aware Dense Retriever fine-tuned with chain-of-thought augmentation on 20k+ reasoning-intensive pairs. Evaluated on MM-BRIGHT across 29 domains, MEMORA achieves nDCG@10 of 41.5 (text-to-text) and 38.9 (multimodal query-to-text), outperforming the strongest agentic text-only baseline by +8.3 points and the strongest agentic multimodal baseline by +7.9 points. Code and data are available at https://github.com/HarnessLab/MEMORA.

papers.title_en: ConStore: Search-Overlapped Prefetch and Co-Retrieval-Aware Content Storage for Disk-Based ANNS
papers.authors: Zhutao Zhuang, Nong Xiao, Zhiguang Chen, Yue Yu
papers.evidence: 面向磁盘RAG的内容存储引擎降低端到端检索延迟
papers.tldr: 磁盘ANNS端到端检索中，大K下内容读取延迟可与向量搜索相当，现有研究却多聚焦小K搜索。ConStore用推测式内联预取SICP重叠内容读取与搜索，并用共检索感知分组RPAG、自适应段重组WASR和组内容抓取GCF降低读取成本。在多跳QA、K=10至1600上，端到端延迟较逐文档读取基线最高降48%（DiskANN）和25%（SPANN），并在亿级至十亿级索引验证扩展性。该工作为大规模RAG与搜索推荐的内容存储协同优化提供了实用方案。
papers.abstract_en: Disk-based approximate nearest-neighbor search (ANNS) supports retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), search, recommendation, and advertising over corpora that exceed memory capacity. Existing ANNS research often focuses on vector search at small top-K, whereas industrial-scale applications require larger retrieval sets. Fetching the corresponding content from storage remains comparatively underexplored. Our profiling across million- to billion-vector corpora shows that, at large K, content fetch latency can match or exceed vector-search latency and cannot be ignored in end-to-end retrieval.   We present ConStore, a content storage engine combining two complementary techniques to reduce end-to-end retrieval latency. Speculative Inline Content Prefetch (SICP) commonly abstracts graph-based and cluster-based ANNS as progressive SSD I/O that refines an in-flight candidate queue. It prefetches content for stable leading candidates under a bounded I/O budget, overlapping content reads with search without changing the final top-K results. Co-Retrieval-Pattern-Aware Grouping (RPAG) uses query logs to place frequently co-retrieved documents in contiguous segments. Workload-Adaptive Segment Reorganization (WASR) adapts this layout to workload shifts by selectively regrouping segments under a bounded rewrite budget. Group Content Fetch (GCF) exploits this layout to coalesce per-document random reads into batched, page-aware I/O requests. SICP works independently of the content layout, while RPAG and GCF reduce fetch cost even without prefetching.   Across three multi-hop QA workloads with K from 10 to 1600, ConStore reduces end-to-end retrieval latency over the best per-document-read baseline by up to 48% on DiskANN and 25% on SPANN. Separate experiments on 100M- and billion-vector indexes demonstrate SICP's applicability at larger scales.

papers.title_en: Private Retrieval Augmented Generation via Random Projection
papers.authors: Dixi Yao, Tahseen Rabbani, Tian Li
papers.evidence: 面向LLM检索增强的隐私保护检索
papers.tldr: RAG通过检索外部知识增强大模型，但可能泄露检索数据存储中的敏感信息。本文提出对数据存储与查询嵌入施加相同随机投影的轻量隐私保护方法，并理论保持查询与检索项的语义相似性。在多种RAG架构和数据集上，该方法的检索与生成性能优于依赖形式化差分隐私的先前方法，在强攻击下经验隐私性相当。结果表明随机投影可作为隐私保护RAG的实用竞争基线。
papers.abstract_en: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) enhances the capabilities of large language models (LLMs) by querying external structured knowledge. However, it can also introduce privacy risks by leaking sensitive information from the retrieval datastore. We propose a simple method to preserve datastore privacy in RAG systems via random projection. By applying the same projection to both datastore embeddings and query embeddings, our method provably preserves semantic similarity between queries and retrieved items while substantially mitigating data extraction attacks. Across multiple RAG architectures and datasets, we show that this lightweight approach achieves superior retrieval and generation performance compared to prior methods which leverage formal differential privacy (DP) guarantees, while exhibiting comparable empirical privacy under strong attack models. Our results for the first time suggest that random projection can serve as a competitive and practical baseline for privacy-preserving RAG systems.

papers.title_en: Selm: Self-Evolving Library Management for Multi-Skill Agent Optimization
papers.authors: Mengxi Hu, Yuxuan Hu, Jinbo Su, Ke Wang, Honghao Shi, Wenli Wu, Cuiping Li, Hong Chen, Jing Zhang
papers.evidence: 具备效用感知检索与更新的自演化技能库
papers.tldr: LLM 智能体越来越多地借助技能获取任务特定知识，但现有技能演化方法缺少系统化管理，导致跨领域复用和积累困难。SELM 把技能演化转化为技能库级管理，联合优化技能检索、更新与生命周期，并维护置信度和效用信号。在四个智能体基准上，SELM 在多数设置下稳定优于基线，表明系统化管理可提升复杂任务表现并促进经验积累。
papers.abstract_en: Large language model (LLM) agents increasingly use skills as a lightweight way to acquire task-specific knowledge. Recent work enables skills to evolve from task trajectories. However, these methods often lack systematic management of evolved skills, making it difficult for agents to reuse and accumulate skills across domains, thus limiting performance on subsequent tasks.To reliably accumulate, reuse, and maintain useful skills across tasks, we present SELM (Self-Evolving Library Management), a framework that formulates skill evolution as library-level management. SELM jointly manages skill retrieval, updating, and lifecycle by maintaining skill confidence and utility signals. It introduces utility-aware retrieval to select useful skills, a Map-Reduce framework to generate targeted updates from task-specific experience, and lifecycle controls to retain or remove skills based on their effectiveness. These mechanisms enable the skill library to continuously accumulate useful experience while preserving and pruning skills across tasks, improving agent performance on complex tasks across diverse domains. We evaluate SELM on four agent benchmarks covering diverse tasks and execution environments, and SELM consistently outperforms in most settings.

papers.title_en: Joint Constraint Aggregation for Qualifier-Sensitive Retrieval-Augmented QA
papers.authors: Jennifer Hsia, Zachary C. Lipton, Aarti Singh
papers.evidence: 检索增强问答中基于证据的约束聚合
papers.tldr: 检索增强问答即使证据含正确答案也可能失败：竞争答案满足部分要求且出现频繁，容易被误判为最佳支持。为此提出联合约束聚合（JCA），用同一组问题约束比较候选答案。在三种评测设置和三种指令微调骨干上，JCA提升总体准确率，且当检索偏向竞争答案时优势更明显。这表明按问题完整要求比较候选可提升选择可靠性。
papers.abstract_en: Retrieval-augmented QA can fail even when the correct answer is in the retrieved evidence. This can happen when a competing answer satisfies some, but not all, of the question's requirements and is mentioned frequently in the retrieved documents, which can make it appear to be the best-supported answer. To test whether this retrieval skew actually affects the decision, we manipulate it directly: increasing the prevalence of passages that favor the competing answer makes the model more likely to select it. This points to a decision problem that candidate-level support alone cannot resolve. We therefore introduce Joint Constraint Aggregation (JCA), which compares candidates against the same question-derived requirements using the retrieved evidence. Across three evaluation settings and three instruction-tuned backbones, JCA improves overall accuracy, and its advantage grows when retrieval favors a competing answer. Together, these results suggest that when partial matches and retrieval prominence pull models toward a competing answer, comparing candidates against the question's full requirements can make selection more reliable.
